description: This file defines serialization and copying logic for the 'object' type within the Orleans framework, including ObjectCodec and ObjectCopier classes.

classes.name: ObjectCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the object type, implementing reading and writing of object instances.

classes.name: ObjectCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for the object type, providing deep copy functionality.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an object value from the reader, handling references and specific serializers.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reads an object instance from the reader, ensuring wire type and length.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes an object field, selecting the appropriate serializer or handling null references.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object, with special handling for the base object type.
